Rest.fullRestHint: Recover all HP, all powers and Backgrounds, and remove Bless/Curse cards.

Notify.deckEmpty: Not enough cards in the Modifier Deck.

cardFace.name: Modifier card faces
cardFace.hint: How modifier cards are displayed for you: Gloomhaven-style faces, or the matching playing card (for groups using a poker deck).

Perk.none: No perks yet. Add one and enter its cards from your class's perk list.
Perk.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. Replace a −1 with a +0 Wound
Perk.codesHint: Each box below is one checkbox of the perk. Write cards as playing-card codes: 7♥ or 7H, 10S, AC, RJ / BJ for jokers. Separate several cards with spaces or +.

issue.invalidCode: {perk} (box {box}): "{code}" is not a valid card code.
issue.missingCard: {perk} (box {box}): {code} is not in the deck, so it can't be removed.
issue.duplicateCard: {perk} (box {box}): {code} is already in the deck. Groups using a poker deck can't have it twice.

import.title: Import perks
import.hint: Choose a JSON file of perks (one class file, for example). Perks whose name already exists on this mercenary are skipped.
